input: The active project (read from the database), a probe backend factory bound by the composing process to this computer, whether a player works, and a cancel flag.
output: Every clip of the project whose media record is still a camera record is completed once through qnc-record-probe (without a probe, and without touching the card, when nothing is missing) and its final record is published to the project content; it waits while any player works. A clip whose probe was interrupted (did not start or ran out of time) goes back to the end of the queue, at most 3 tries in one run; a later run takes it again. QNC v5 ingest_probe/scheduler.rs.
